## Purpose

Merge the control samples from the long-term and short-term epithelial arms into one
Harmony-integrated object, annotate it, remove the immune clusters, and compare
duodenum vs ileum.

The no-immune object produced here is the handoff for two downstream analyses:
the master scRNA reference (Figure S5) and the stem/TA populations used in the
ligand–receptor analysis (Figures 6F–6G, S8).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Inputs** | `../../02-epithelia-clustering/outputs/long-term_seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_transfer_labels-UCell-Added.RDS`<br>`../../02-epithelia-clustering/outputs/short-term_seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed.RDS`<br>`../data/updated-cell-type-labels-for-IKJOT.csv`<br>`../data/Combined-cell-type-annotations.csv` |
| **Key outputs** | `../outputs/epithelia_EP.CTRL_data.processed.RDS`<br>`../outputs/epithelia_EP.CTRL_data.processed(no-immune).RDS` **← the handoff object**<br>`../outputs/epithelia_DE_Genes.Duodenum.Vs.Ileum-CTRL-cell-type-*.csv` |

Paths are relative to this `scripts/` directory. Run with the working directory set here.

## 0. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CHERRYPIC_R_LIB"))) .libPaths(c(Sys.getenv("CHERRYPIC_R_LIB"), .libPaths()))  # optional custom library

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(harmony)
library(glue)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

out <- function(f) file.path("../outputs", f)
```

## 1. Load the per-arm epithelial objects

```{r load-arms}
longterm.ep  <- readRDS("../../02-epithelia-clustering/outputs/long-term_seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_transfer_labels-UCell-Added.RDS")
shorterm.ep  <- readRDS("../../02-epithelia-clustering/outputs/short-term_seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed.RDS")

# Short-term clustering of record is res 0.7.
shorterm.ep@meta.data$seurat_clusters <- shorterm.ep@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.0.7
Idents(shorterm.ep) <- shorterm.ep$seurat_clusters

# The long-term arm carries its labels from the earlier transfer step.
longterm.ep@meta.data$cell_type_label_final <- longterm.ep@meta.data$predicted_transfer_label
```

## 2. Attach the short-term cell-type labels

The CSV maps short-term res-0.7 cluster numbers to three parallel labelling schemes.

```{r shortterm-labels}
updated_labels <- read.csv("../data/updated-cell-type-labels-for-IKJOT.csv",
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cluster_to_specific <- setNames(updated_labels$specific.cell.type.label, updated_labels$seurat_clusters)
cluster_to_general  <- setNames(updated_labels$general.cell.type.label,  updated_labels$seurat_clusters)
cluster_to_old      <- setNames(updated_labels$old.cell.type.labels,     updated_labels$seurat_clusters)

stopifnot("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(shorterm.ep@meta.data))

# unname() is required: named vectors trigger a "No cell overlap" error on assignment.
shorterm.ep$specific_cell_type_label <- unname(cluster_to_specific[as.character(Idents(shorterm.ep))])
shorterm.ep$general_cell_type_label  <- unname(cluster_to_general[as.character(shorterm.ep$seurat_clusters)])
shorterm.ep$old_cell_type_labels     <- unname(cluster_to_old[as.character(shorterm.ep$seurat_clusters)])
```

```{r shortterm-label-qc, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(shorterm.ep, group.by = "specific_cell_type_label", label = TRUE, label.size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Short-term: specific labels") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
DimPlot(shorterm.ep, group.by = "general_cell_type_label", label = TRUE, label.size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Short-term: general labels") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
DimPlot(shorterm.ep, group.by = "old_cell_type_labels", label = TRUE, label.size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Short-term: old labels") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 3. Subset to controls and merge

```{r merge-controls}
longterm.ep.CTRL_only <- longterm.ep[, longterm.ep@meta.data$Condition == "Control"]
shorterm.ep.CTRL_only <- shorterm.ep[, shorterm.ep@meta.data$Condition == "Control"]

EP.CTRL_data <- merge(longterm.ep.CTRL_only, shorterm.ep.CTRL_only)

# Split the RNA assay by sequencing run so Harmony has something to integrate over.
EP.CTRL_data <- JoinLayers(EP.CTRL_data)
EP.CTRL_data[["RNA"]] <- split(EP.CTRL_data[["RNA"]], f = EP.CTRL_data$orig.ident)
Layers(EP.CTRL_data)
```

## 4. Harmony reprocessing

```{r pipeline-def}
multi_sample_pipeline <- function(merged_seu_obj, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA") {
  if (res_cols == "SCT") {
    merged_seu_obj <- SCTransform(merged_seu_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  } else {
    merged_seu_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- ScaleData(merged_seu_obj)
  }
  merged_seu_obj <- RunPCA(merged_seu_obj)
  # Harmony's k-means initialisation is stochastic and carries no default seed,
  # unlike RunUMAP (seed.use = 42) and FindClusters (random.seed = 0).
  set.seed(42)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunHarmony(merged_seu_obj, assay.use = res_cols, group.by.vars = split_col)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunUMAP(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindNeighbors(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindClusters(merged_seu_obj, resolution = c(1:10 / 10))
  merged_seu_obj
}
```

```{r run-pipeline}
EP.CTRL_data.processed <- multi_sample_pipeline(EP.CTRL_data)
```

## 5. Transfer the short-term labels onto the merged object

```{r label-transfer}
shorterm.ep.CTRL_only <- RunPCA(shorterm.ep.CTRL_only, verbose = FALSE)
shorterm.ep.CTRL_only <- RunUMAP(shorterm.ep.CTRL_only, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)

transfer.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = shorterm.ep.CTRL_only,
  query     = EP.CTRL_data.processed,
  dims      = 1:30,
  reference.reduction = "pca"
)

# Same anchors, three label schemes.
for (scheme in c("specific_cell_type_label", "general_cell_type_label", "old_cell_type_labels")) {
  td <- TransferData(anchorset = transfer.anchors,
                     refdata   = shorterm.ep.CTRL_only[[scheme]][, 1],
                     dims      = 1:30)
  EP.CTRL_data.processed@meta.data[[scheme]]              <- td$predicted.id
  EP.CTRL_data.processed@meta.data[[paste0(scheme, "_score")]] <- td$prediction.score.max
}

EP.CTRL_data.processed$predicted.id       <- NULL
EP.CTRL_data.processed$prediction.score.max <- NULL
```

```{r transfer-qc, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(EP.CTRL_data.processed, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.7", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Clusters (res 0.7)") |
  DimPlot(EP.CTRL_data.processed, group.by = "specific_cell_type_label", label = TRUE, label.size = 2) + ggtitle("Transferred specific labels")
```

## 6. Annotate res 0.8 and remove the immune clusters

```{r annotate-and-split}
cell.type.annot  <- read.csv("../data/Combined-cell-type-annotations.csv")

Idents(EP.CTRL_data.processed) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.8"
new.cluster.ids <- cell.type.annot$cell_type
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(EP.CTRL_data.processed@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.0.8)

EP.CTRL_data.processed <- RenameIdents(EP.CTRL_data.processed, new.cluster.ids)
EP.CTRL_data.processed@meta.data$cell_type_labels <- Idents(EP.CTRL_data.processed)

EP.CTRL_data.processed <- JoinLayers(EP.CTRL_data.processed)
EP.CTRL_data.processed <- NormalizeData(EP.CTRL_data.processed)

EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune <- subset(
  EP.CTRL_data.processed,
  EP.CTRL_data.processed@meta.data$cell_type_labels != "Immune")
EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune <- JoinLayers(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune)
EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune <- NormalizeData(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune)
```

## 7. Save the handoff objects

```{r save-objects}
saveRDS(EP.CTRL_data.processed,           out("epithelia_EP.CTRL_data.processed.RDS"))
saveRDS(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune, out("epithelia_EP.CTRL_data.processed(no-immune).RDS"))
```

```{r composition}
composition.df <- table(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune@meta.data$cell_type_labels,
                        EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune@meta.data$Location) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%

black.bold.16.text <- element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 14,
```

## 9. Duodenum vs Ileum differential expression

```{r de-global}
DE_Genes.DuodenumVsIleum <- FindMarkers(
  EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune,
  group.by = "Location", ident.1 = "Duodenum", ident.2 = "Ileum", assay = "RNA") %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05)

write.csv(DE_Genes.DuodenumVsIleum,
          out("epithelia_DE_Genes.DuodenumVsIleum-CTRL(Epithelial-Cells-only).csv"))
```

Per cell type. `DE_Genes.Duodenum.Vs.Ileum-CTRL-cell-type-Enterocytes-only.csv` from this
loop is the input table behind the Figure 3F bubble panel.

```{r de-per-celltype}
cell.types.of.interest <- c("SC", "Enterocytes", "TA", "Goblet",
                            "Pre-enterocytes", "Tuft", "Paneth", "Enteroendocrine")

for (x in cell.types.of.interest) {
  tryCatch({
    subset_data <- subset(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune, cell_type_labels %in% c(x))
    de <- FindMarkers(subset_data, group.by = "Location",
                      ident.1 = "Duodenum", ident.2 = "Ileum", assay = "RNA") %>%
      dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05)

    write.csv(de, out(glue("epithelia_DE_Genes.Duodenum.Vs.Ileum-CTRL-cell-type-{x}-only.csv")))

    pdf(out(glue("epithelia_Volcano-Plot-DE_Genes.Duodenum.Vs.Ileum-CTRL-cell-type-{x}-only.pdf")))
    print(EnhancedVolcano::EnhancedVolcano(de, x = "avg_log2FC", y = "p_val_adj",
                                           lab = rownames(de)))
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) message(glue("skipped {x}: {conditionMessage(e)}")))
}
```

## 10. Duodenum vs Ileum heatmaps

```{r heatmaps}
EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune <- ScaleData(
  EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune,
  features = Features(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune))

top100.Duodenum.Genes <- DE_Genes.DuodenumVsIleum %>% dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% slice_head(n = 100)
top100.Ileum.Genes    <- DE_Genes.DuodenumVsIleum %>% dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC < 0) %>% slice_head(n = 100)

# NOTE: the original notebook also plotted objects named `top100` and `top50` that were
# never defined in the file — they existed only in the interactive session. Reconstructed
# here as the top 100 / top 50 rows of the significant DE table. Verify before reuse.
top100 <- DE_Genes.DuodenumVsIleum %>% slice_head(n = 100)
top50  <- DE_Genes.DuodenumVsIleum %>% slice_head(n = 50)

both <- c(rownames(top100.Duodenum.Genes), rownames(top100.Ileum.Genes))

pdf(out("epithelia_HEATMAP-EP.CTRL_data-Top-100-Upregulated-genes-in-Duodenum-and-Ileum.pdf"),
    height = 30, width = 15)
DoHeatmap(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune, features = both, group.by = "Location")
dev.off()

pdf(out("epithelia_HEATMAP-EP.CTRL_data-Top-100-Upregulated-genes-in-Duodenum-and-Ileum(Grouped-by-Cell-Type).pdf"),
    height = 30, width = 15)
DoHeatmap(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune, features = both, group.by = "cell_type_labels")
dev.off()

pdf(out("epithelia_HEATMAP-EP.CTRL_data-Top-100-DE-genes-DuodenumVsIleum.pdf"))
DoHeatmap(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune, features = rownames(top100), group.by = "Location") + NoLegend()
dev.off()

pdf(out("epithelia_HEATMAP-EP.CTRL_data-Top-50-DE-genes-DuodenumVsIleum.pdf"))
DoHeatmap(EP.CTRL_data.processed.no_immune, features = rownames(top50), group.by = "Location") + NoLegend()
dev.off()
```
